name: agent-fs-install-registry
body:
The install registry that ships the fs tools: the plugin registry in `rust.apg.install` (`src/install.rs`) carries one `(filename, include_str!(...))` entry per tool (`apg_rm.ts`, `apg_mv.ts`, `apg_cp.ts`), so `apg init` embeds and installs them as opencode 2.x plugins under `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` like every other suite plugin. The registry is consumed by `rust.apg.install.install_suite`, which writes each entry to the plugin dir. The registry is a `const`, so the module `rust.apg.install` is the graph-resolvable anchor for the registry entry.

implemented-by: `rust.apg.install` (the registry const's module) and the install-assertion e2e `rust.main_e2e.e2e.suite_installs_node_edge_project_tools_and_retires_spec_invariant`, which asserts the three tools are embedded and installed.
